assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: Tasks 1-4 include convention rationales in the prescribed format. Examples: Task 1 has 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §Module Pattern: follow the model/ + service/ + endpoints/ structure... Applies: task creates modules/fundamental/src/sbom/model/license_report.rs matching the convention's model directory scope.' Task 2 has 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §Query Helpers: use shared query builder helpers... Applies: task creates modules/fundamental/src/sbom/service/license_report.rs matching the convention's .rs file scope.' Task 3 has 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §Endpoint Registration: register the route... Applies: task modifies modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/mod.rs matching the convention's endpoint registration scope.' All rationales name specific files and convention scopes. No 'Not applicable' annotations appear anywhere. Task 5 (documentation) contains no convention references, correctly excluding file-type-scoped conventions that don't apply to a docs task.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9004 has Priority: Major (not Undefined). The impact-map.md states: 'Priority: Major (propagated to all tasks)' in the Inherited Field Values section. The summary-comment.md states: 'Priority: Major — propagated to all 5 tasks. The Feature has priority "Major" (not "Undefined"), so it is included in additional_fields on every created task.' The summary also shows the additional_fields JSON with '"priority": {"name": "Major"}' applied to each task.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9004 has Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (non-empty). No '### Jira Field Defaults' section exists in CLAUDE.md, so scope defaults to 'both'. The impact-map.md states: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (propagated to all tasks; no fixVersion scope setting in CLAUDE.md ### Jira Field Defaults, defaulting to "both")'. The summary-comment.md states: 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.5.0 — propagated to all 5 tasks. The Feature has a non-empty fixVersions array, and no fixVersion scope setting exists in CLAUDE.md ### Jira Field Defaults, so the default scope "both" applies (propagate to tasks).' The additional_fields JSON shows '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: A summary-comment.md file exists in the outputs directory containing an 'Inherited Field Values' section with: 'Priority: Major — propagated to all 5 tasks' and 'fixVersions: RHTPA 1.5.0 — propagated to all 5 tasks', along with the additional_fields JSON block. Additionally, the impact-map.md also contains an 'Inherited Field Values' section documenting both propagated fields.
